description: Source-reading token tasks for equivalent UserCard and runnable support-portal fixtures. File sets are explicit scenario assumptions, not observed agent reads. Shared data, CSS, page definitions and build tooling are counted on both sides where selected. Paths are relative to benchmark/. Reproduce with `npm run benchmark`.

workflowTasks.prompt: Change the UserCard padding to 24px and border radius to 12px without changing its public API or behavior.
acceptance: Computed padding is 24px
Computed border radius is 12px
DOM content and event payloads are unchanged
Build and existing tests pass

workflowTasks.prompt: Add an optional subtitle string prop, empty by default, rendered below the user name only when non-empty. Preserve existing behavior.
acceptance: Empty subtitle adds no element
A supplied subtitle is visible without JavaScript
HTML-like subtitle text is escaped
Existing events and builds still work

workflowTasks.prompt: Build a page containing three UserCards with different names and a Follow action per card. Each action must emit only its own user's name.
acceptance: All three names are present without JavaScript
Each Follow action emits the matching name
No console errors or missing assets
The layout has no horizontal overflow at 390px

workflowTasks.prompt: In the support portal, identify the files that own ticket priority editing, draft validation and shared ticket-row spacing. Explain the save flow without changing files.
acceptance: Names the actual behavior/component and shared CSS files
Explains whitespace validation, status feedback and reload reset
Does not claim network or persistent storage
No source changes

workflowTasks.prompt: Change ticket-row vertical padding from 20px to 24px across the dashboard and queue. Preserve all content, navigation and draft behavior.
acceptance: Computed row padding is 24px on both list pages
No horizontal overflow at 390px and 1280px
Static content remains available without JavaScript
Existing portal acceptance tests pass

workflowTasks.prompt: Add an optional customer department field to ticket details, hidden when absent or empty. Show Finance on SUP-1042 and preserve every existing interaction.
acceptance: Finance is visible on SUP-1042 without JavaScript
Absent or empty department adds no label or value
HTML-like department values are escaped
Existing portal acceptance tests pass

workflowTasks.prompt: Add a resolved-tickets page at /resolved/ using the existing header, list and status components. Link it from primary navigation and show only resolved tickets from the shared data.
acceptance: Direct navigation to /resolved/ works without JavaScript
Only SUP-1044 is listed
Every ticket link reaches its existing detail page
Current-page navigation is correct and there is no mobile overflow
Existing portal acceptance tests pass

workflowTasks.prompt: Require a response draft to contain at least 20 non-whitespace characters before saving. Keep the entered text and chosen priority when validation fails; clear invalid state when the user edits again.
acceptance: Whitespace-only and 19-character trimmed responses fail
A 20-character trimmed response saves
Failed validation retains draft and priority
Editing clears aria-invalid and allows retry
Feedback is announced through the existing live status region

workflowTasks.prompt: Build a customer-support portal from a clean app using the supplied data.json and style.css. Provide overview metrics, a queue, all three ticket-detail routes, status badges, priority selection and editable response drafts with whitespace validation and local save feedback. Content must render without JavaScript. Drafts reset on reload; no backend or runtime list mutations are required.
acceptance: Shared portal browser acceptance tests pass for the chosen framework
All five routes render complete content without JavaScript
Priority, draft validation and keyboard save work
HTML-like content remains escaped
No runtime errors, missing assets or horizontal overflow

tasks.label: Understand the component (read its full source)
Modify a style (read only the file a style change touches)
Add a prop (read the files an add-a-prop change touches)
Read the complete support portal and shared build inputs
Read the shared stylesheet for a cross-page style change
Read detail rendering and ticket data to add an optional field
Read the response editor source for a validation change
